arguments.command:
python -c "
import semver

# Test replace with more complex versions
print('Testing replace with complex versions:')
print(semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5', major=2))  # Should be 2.0.0
print(semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5', minor=5))  # Should be 1.5.0
print(semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5', patch=4))  # Should be 1.2.4
print(semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5', prerelease='beta'))  # Should be 1.2.3-beta+build.5
print(semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5', build='newbuild'))  # Should be 1.2.3-alpha.1+newbuild

# Test VersionInfo.replace with complex versions
v = semver.VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5')
print()
print('VersionInfo.replace tests:')
print(v.replace(major=2))
print(v.replace(minor=5))
print(v.replace(patch=4))
print(v.replace(prerelease='beta'))
print(v.replace(build='newbuild'))
"
